$description: Booth settings (guidelines/print/booths.md, visual designer, 2026-11-27). Sizes in mm unless named in in. The vendor's spec always wins for size, bleed, safe area, keep-clear zones, dpi, color profile and file format. Values marked 'to confirm' are proposals from the WCNA26 test.

margin.$value: 8% of the short side, at least 1.5 x safe
margin.$description: Print margin (README.md section 2); also the logo's clear space

title.$description: pt, the largest the heading may be; it shrinks until its longest word fits its column

titleMin.$description: pt, about 90 mm cap height (to confirm: the WCNA26 tagline landed at 382 pt, 96 mm)

supporting.$description: pt, about 32 mm cap height: supporting text, stats and labels

capRatio.$description: Mona Sans cap height / font size, for the size checks

heightShare.$description: Logo height as a share of a wall's height: 5.9 in on the 95 in WCNA26 wall, 20% smaller than the first test (visual designer, 2026-11-27)

counterHeightShare.$description: On counters and cabinets (to confirm: the first test's 170 mm on a 36 in cabinet was too big)

band.$description: in from the floor, standing walls

floorClear.$description: in from the floor: nothing important below (people, stools, counters)

base.$description: Gradient + streaks; direction fixed at 110°. Draft preset: needs approval before real booths

lookAsLayer.$description: No background at all: settings.background null, every colorway backdrop null, engine backdrop 'none'

grain.$description: Noise on the painted background, so gradients don't band in CMYK

clear.$description: in of empty space around each content block

fade.$description: in over which the look fades back in, linear

default.$description: When the spec gives none (Freeman: 100 for 4 to 8 ft viewing)

min.$description: Never below, even for pieces seen from 15 ft or more

dpi.$description: A few seconds each; checks run on them

layoutDpi.$description: Layout and checks; only the background is painted at the vendor's dpi

maxPageIn.$description: Largest PDF page Acrobat opens; bigger walls go at the vendor's scale

color.$description: Only when the spec names no profile (same exception as stickers). The proof says which was used
